Amazing duck!!
Oct 2019
We went here after already having food elsewhere as we really wanted some duck. As we'd already had some food, we decided to only have half a duck which was 185VND which worked out at £6.49 for us, this is probably just a little cheaper than at home in the UK. The duck was amazing! Really tasty and we definetly could have eaten more, if weren't so full! You were allowed sides like cuecumber and onion, they also had two different sauces for you to use. Just as a warning there is only one table in there, I think usualy it's used as a take away option, so be prepared if you do go.

The most amazing duck in Saigon
Dec 2019 • Couples
The most amazing duck in Saigon . Recommended off of watching a 3 recommended places to eat in Chinatown, Ho Chi Minh City and it was 100% . 
Usually a take away shop , they were happy to set up a table so we could eat in . They even went and got us a bottle of water each , because they don’t supply drinks . 
My favourite was the pepper sauce . Staff were amazing , and friendly . 
Highly recommend to any duck lovers

Some of the best duck I've ever had...and I've had a lot of duck.
Sep 2019 • Solo
I was surprised to find there weren't reviews of this all over trip advisor already, as I found it through both a YouTube video and a travel blog elsewhere. Either way I'm told the duck is coated in honey and seasoning and then roasted in large pot with charcoal at the base of it - this is why you'll see black marks on the hung ducks unlike the consistently golden Peking duck.

It's not a restaurant, just a small street food vendor but they'll offer you gloves and you should take them...this is some sticky, greasy, fantastic, delicious, amazing duck.

It's been around for 64 years and you can see why. I've eaten duck all over the place including traditional Peking duck in Beijing but I've never had duck that literally burst with juice and flavor like this. Wonderful and worth the extra work to get to if you're already making the effort to go to Cho Lon and or Cho Bin Tay. The only problem is there's nowhere nice to sit down and enjoy the spoils of your adventuring, so maybe taxi straight back to your hotel or a nice park in D1 before you open that Styrofoam box of flavor heaven. 

I enjoyed mine on the side of the busy road being berated by my wife for dragging the family all the way there to indulge my personal duck desires...it was worth it, and she actually calmed when she tasted it 😂
